scope: decode wrapper host attribution (the R10/R7-endorsed direction: kernel efficiency or wrapper host work - NOT launch restructuring)
method: rocprofv3 hip-api trace around 64 decode steps of code-p512 (runner-direct, serving kwargs capture_logits=False + token_id_resident=True); rocprof inflates walls ~1.5x (82ms vs the R6-measured 54.6ms) - counts are exact, durations inflated
findings: The serving path already uses the device-argmax knob (capture_logits=False via _qwen4_exp_compact_step_kwargs): no full-vocab logits D2H per step in serving TG.

Blocking hipMemcpy durations (520us avg) are stream-wait dominated: they queue behind the step's device work, so they measure device time, not host cost. The 10-11 per-step copies are small state mirrors (positions/PLE/token), not the logits.
447 individual launches + 20 graph launches per step carry the 31-49ms device work (R6/R2e); R10's negative on launch restructuring stands - the launches overlap device execution.

Genuine host levers: consolidate the ~10 small blocking state readbacks per step into fewer async/pinned copies or resident mirrors (est. 0.5-1 ms/token), and the Python wrapper bookkeeping between calls (the remainder of the R6 5.3ms host bucket).
queue_item_6_handoff: the wrapper trace confirms the direction is copy/mirror consolidation + Python bookkeeping, not launch restructuring and not a logits-copy fix (already optimized).

copy_mechanism.verified_by: python-boundary probe with traceback capture (3 steps, code-p512 decode)
copy_mechanism.per_step: 24 x 8-byte blocking H2D (median 23.1us each, ~0.55ms/step genuine) + 2 x 8B D2H (token + scalar) + 1 x 10240B H2D (PLE staged row)
copy_mechanism.source: Qwen4ExpAttentionDeviceState.set_position (qwen4_exp_runner.py:756) called per QSA layer via run_qwen4_exp_dense_qsa_layer -> run_qwen4_exp_qsa_decode_token_mixer (line 2281): 12 QSA layers x 2 copies (position + context), each layer owning a UNIQUE state index (line 2177) so call-site dedup cannot help
fix_directions: device-side position advance: position increments deterministically by 1 per step; one tiny kernel (or fold into an existing one) updates all 12 position/context buffers - zero host copies, integer-exact, +1 launch
pinned host staging + async copies if the launch budget matters more than the copy latency
copy_mechanism.estimated_gain: ~0.5 ms/token (~1% TG), plus restoring CPU/GPU overlap (the blocking copies serialize the stream at step start)

batched_position_candidate.mechanism: one interleaved [position, context] int64 pair per QSA state in a shared 192B device region; step() prepares all 12 states with ONE blocking H2D copy and passes position_prepared=True to the per-layer dense mixer (which skips set_position)
batched_position_candidate.bit_exactness: PASS - identical token digest ea0412231532bc7b across all fixture cases, 3 repetitions per arm
batched_position_candidate.tg_ab: PASS - median 60.26/60.38/60.93 (off) vs 59.36/59.61/59.71 (on) ms/token: -0.77 ms/token (~1.3% TG), beyond the +/-0.9 ms run-to-run spread
batched_position_candidate.copy_surface: 27 -> 4 blocking copies per decode step (24x8B H2D eliminated; rope + PLE row + token readbacks remain)
batched_position_candidate.promotion: recommended - pure host-side, no kernel or numeric change, bit-exact, +1.3% TG

compiler_version_cache_fix.finding: cProfile screen of 64 decode steps exposed 919 _resolve_compiler_version calls per step (one per build_hip on the per-launch path); the env/file branch _compiler_version_from_environment ran BEFORE the _COMPILER_VERSION_CACHE check and re-read the version file from disk every call - measured 8.845 ms/step un-instrumented
compiler_version_cache_fix.fix: non-None env-version cache in hipengine/core/build.py (env/file version is process-static; unset-env path stays dynamic); 9.6us -> 0.09us per resolve
compiler_version_cache_fix.gates: bit-exact token digest ea0412231532bc7b (all fixture cases, separate incumbent/candidate processes); TG median 59.31 (incumbent) vs 57.40/57.48/57.39 (candidate) ms/token = -1.9 ms/token (~3.2%), stable across 3 runs - TG claim WITHDRAWN (measured with the buggy compiler-only cache key; corrected override-identity cache shows ~0 ms TG): see supersessions_and_corrections
compiler_version_cache_fix.note: prefill also pays per-launch resolves (~1700/prefill, ~16ms at p1024) - sub-1% of prefill wall, not separately gated

ple_staging_open_finding.measurement: Qwen4ExpPLEStagingRing.stage costs 19.61 ms/step un-instrumented (np.memmap __getitem__ fancy-index gather, confirmed by cProfile and direct timing)
ple_staging_open_finding.note: largest single host-side item remaining; the staged row is 10KB - the mechanism (likely memmap fancy-index materializing or per-head Python lookups) needs investigation; potential multi-ms/token

ple_page_cache_promotion.finding: PLE staging gather (16 rows/step via np.memmap fancy index) costs 1.4-27.7 ms/step page-fault-bound on cold cache (~10 major faults/step, btrfs-compressed NVMe, ~2ms/fault); case-dependent with code-like content worst

ple_page_cache_promotion.promotion: warm_page_cache() = mmap-touch sweep at runner init (chunked uint64 sum through the byte view); promoted default ON via HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_PLE_WARM with opt-out =0 (5b816d12c) - SUPERSEDED by 0211fe125: DEMOTED to opt-in, default OFF, enable with HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_PLE_WARM=1 (see ple_resource_qualification and supersessions_and_corrections)
ple_page_cache_promotion.gates: bit-exact digest ea0412231532bc7b both arms (cold-cache A/B with POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED reset); TG median 57.14 (off) vs 52.33 (on) ms/token = -4.8 ms (~8.4%), mean 61.86 -> 52.68
ple_page_cache_promotion.cost: one-time ~15 s sequential pass at generator construction (28.8 GB at ~1.9 GB/s); long-lived serving amortizes instantly

ple_resource_qualification.trigger: review findings 1+4: promoted before resource qualification

measurements.method: fresh-process counterbalanced arms, POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED reset of all GGUF shards before each arm, current HEAD, GPU otherwise idle
measurements.warm_sweep_cost: +15.4 s and +6,015 major faults PER RUNNER CONSTRUCTION (28.8 GB read from storage; re-construction in a warm process re-touches at memory speed but is not free)
measurements.page_cache_delta: Cached grew 23.8 GB (off) vs 27.1 GB (on) at construction end - the sweep's residency competes with weight-load streaming; standing host state during qualification: 19 GB swap in use, 110 GB available

ple_resource_qualification.amortization_tokens: 15.4 s / per-case saving: code-p512 577, code-p1024 681, code-p4096 1,077, general_en-p512 2,139, general_en-p1024 1,750, general_en-p4096 2,000, general_ja-p512 2,139, general_ja-p1024 15,400, general_ja-p4096 5,310, mixed-p512 5,923, mixed-p1024 9,059, mixed-p4096 5,923; median ~2,050
ple_resource_qualification.comparator_confound_finding_4: the sweep's 28.8 GB clean-page residency is reclaimable but competes with co-resident engines' host staging; the v8b2 capture memwatch recorded free=0 GB and PSI 1.65 mid-capture with warm-on (multi-cause). 'Comparators cannot be affected' retracted; the mechanism is shared page-cache pressure, quantified as the residency above
ple_resource_qualification.long_context_finding: PLE staging is per-token and context-independent; the p4096 cases in both arms exercise the 4352-context admission with no interaction
ple_resource_qualification.decision: DEMOTED TO OPT-IN (default off, HIPENGINE_QWEN4_EXP_PLE_WARM=1 to enable). Blocker: amortization (median ~2,050 tokens; benches at ~576 tokens/construction never amortize) plus unqualified memory behavior on constrained shared hosts. The optimization is preserved and recommended for long-lived serving deployments
